description: Only way to order: the link to its Rabbit page, at their quantity, one or several models; they pay there, Rabbit buys on 1688, photos at the warehouse, shipped to them or Amazon. Use when they want to order: this link, as it is, is the only one that opens their order. See the product: read_product_page.

pays.description: The delivery country (two letters), if they named one; otherwise their account’s country.

produit.description: The `produit` reference returned by a search (starts with “p”).

quantite.description: The number of pieces the client said.

repartition.description: An order over several models (“30 in 24/25, 40 in 26/27”): one model and its quantity per line, in the page’s words. One link, one payment; replaces quantite and variante.

variante.description: The model, as the product page names it.
The size, color or model they said (optional).

title: Order
